answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond linked to verified work history: an agent must lock collateral and show proof of sustained useful computation before it can trade. Each new identity then costs real money and compute, while a single honest agent pays once and reuses its bond. A sparrow cannot fake the weight of a flock, and a gale of fake accounts hits its nadir when every copy must be funded, because flooding the network quickly becomes too expensive to sustain.
